text_block_list.text: ――On a day off, I spotted a rather chipper Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm, hmm... ♪ Go, go, let's go, Victories!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have waited so long for this day desu wa♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must slip into the karaoke booth before anyone notices, or else――
choice_data_list: Going to karaoke?
Going to karaoke?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My?! T-T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Mmm... y-yes, precisely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I was, well... yes, merely practicing for the Winning Live!
choice_data_list: Then I'll go with you.
Then I'll go with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eh? Trainer, you intend to join me?
choice_data_list:
You're practicing for the Winning Live, right? 
I'll help you.

You're practicing for the Winning Live, right? 
I'll help you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so... Thank you very much. 
In that case, let us enter together...
Sensing something unusual about Mejiro McQueen, I tagged along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew, that ought to suffice desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How was my singing just now? Should you have suggestions for 
improvement, please do tell.
Even after a few songs, McQueen showed little enthusiasm.
Where had her upbeat mood gone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is something amiss?
choice_data_list: Did I get in your way…?
Did I get in your way…?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Intruding...?! No, that is not...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Not in the slightest! It is just... how should I explain――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose honesty is best here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I did not come here to practice for the Winning Live. 
My actual reason was――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...... I-I wished to belt out a fight song desu wa.
choice_data_list: Cheering song?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed... The roaring cheers fans shout during matches...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I enjoy watching baseball... purely a passing interest, of course!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: On days off, I occasionally visit karaoke rooms alone to sing cheering songs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So today, my plan was to...
choice_data_list: Then let's sing!
Then let's sing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-impossible! Making such an undignified ruckus in front of you is simply out of the question...!
choice_data_list: Well, then I'll sing.
Well, then I'll sing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What...? You, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-wait! I have been holding back all this time......!
choice_data_list: Then let's sing together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, but displaying such unrefined conduct――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, track is already playing?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Mmm... If matters have come to this, I have no choice desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Go for it! YU・TA・KA!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Go for it! YU・TA・KA!
Though hesitant at first, McQueen soon got lost in the rhythm.
By the end, she shouted as passionately as any stadium fan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe... A bit embarrassing, but thoroughly refreshing to sing full blast desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now I feel like heading straight to ballpark.
choice_data_list: How did you come to love watching sports?
How did you come to love watching sports?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good question... Likely due to stadium's electric atmosphere desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As lady of Mejiro family, I strive 
to remain disciplined and composed at all times, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
First time I attended sporting event, I was utterly 
astounded by venue's atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Environment where one may express excitement freely. 
Space where passionate cheering draws no scorn…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I find peculiar freedom of 
stadium exceedingly refreshing and captivating.
choice_data_list: You've discovered a new kind of fun.
You've discovered a new kind of fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, precisely that, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us conclude our discussion for now and 
proceed to next song. Which shall we select?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh…… How terribly embarrassing. To think 
I shouted with such abandon……
choice_data_list: But it looked like you were having a great time.
But it looked like you were having a great time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, well… it has been quite some time 
since I enjoyed singing so thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ……However, Trainer. Promise me this at least.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Speak of today to no one. And, if possible, 
erase today's events from memory entirely, please…
